name: The six-coefficient Frobenius algebra formed by Fourier coefficients a_1..a_6
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

The six-coefficient Frobenius algebra formed by Fourier coefficients a_1..a_6 of f_HT Basis b_0..

phase_0.boundary_condition: The 7-dimensional vector space spanned by basis b_0..b_6 with multiplicative identity b_0=1 and Frobenius product mu satisfying mu∘delta=id via coproduct delta(b_i)=b_i⊗b_0
phase_0.domain_name: The six-coefficient Frobenius algebra formed by Fourier coefficients a_1..a_6
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism that combines two basis elements into one via addition modulo 7, the primitive operation of the group algebra.

AREV.justification: The descent morphism that reverses the index to its additive inverse modulo 7, implementing the Z2 symmetry of the Frobenius algebra.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of the coproduct followed by the product, which yields the identity by the Frobenius condition.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: b_0 + b_0 (or the algebra itself viewed as both true and false)
ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of both identity and non-identity under the paraconsistent interpretation, e.g., the element 2b_0 where the truth lattice is unresolved.

EVALF.chosen_element: Linear functional that picks trace of left multiplication by b_0
EVALF.justification: The negative branch of the evaluation, returning zero in the group algebra case but conceptually the failure state.

EVALT.chosen_element: Linear functional epsilon: b_i → 1 for i=0, else 0
EVALT.justification: The evaluation that picks the coefficient of b_0, corresponding to the affirmative truth state (the counit of the Frobenius algebra).

FFUSE.justification: The product fuses two factors into one basis element; when applied to the output of delta, it reconstitutes the original element exactly.

FSPLIT.justification: The coproduct splits a single basis element into a tensor product of itself and the identity element, opening a two-factor arm.

IFIX.chosen_element: Structure constants C_ijk (0 or 1) stored in ROM
IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of the multiplication table as permanent record; once defined, the constants cannot be altered.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity morphism on the vector space; each basis element is self-recognized without transformation.

TANCH.justification: The multiplicative identity that closes the algebra under product; every element multiplied by b_0 returns itself, anchoring the entire structure.

VINIT.chosen_element: Scalar field (R or C) prior to basis assignment
VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated coefficient space from which all linear combinations are drawn; the void before any basis vector is named.

phase_3.both_description: b_0 + 0 = b_0 (or the full algebra as superposition); in the dialetheia sense, both identity and zero are held without resolution.
phase_3.false_description: Zero vector 0, the additive identity representing the negative truth value.
phase_3.true_description: b_0 = 1, the multiplicative identity representing the affirmative truth value.
phase_3.void_description: Scalar field before any basis element is instantiated; all coefficients are zero.

steps.domain_action: Scalar field initialized with no basis designated.
Identity element b_0 introduced as the terminal anchor of the algebra.
Product mu: b_i ⊗ b_j → b_{i+j mod 7} defined for all i,j.
Coproduct delta applied to an arbitrary basis element b_i, splitting it into b_i ⊗ b_0.
Product mu fuses the two factors back into b_i, confirming mu∘delta=id.
Involution applied: b_i → b_{-i mod 7}; each element paired with its inverse.
Counit epsilon evaluates the coefficient of b_0 from a linear combination, giving an affirmative truth value.
Alternative evaluation returns zero for non-identity components, marking the false branch.
The element 2b_0 is considered as both true and false simultaneously under the paraconsistent interpretation.
Composition mu∘delta is chained to demonstrate that the identity is recovered.
Identity morphism id applied to b_i leaves the element unchanged.
Structure constants C_ijk recorded as permanent, immutable table entries.

phase_5.alfs_store: Canonical table of Z7 addition modulo 7, stored as the bootstrap reference for structure constants.
phase_5.compiler_frontend: Group algebra construction from the cyclic group Z7, mapping group elements to basis vectors.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Tensor product facilities that allow pairs of basis elements to be combined under mu or split under delta.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Coefficient array of length 7 storing linear combinations of basis elements, with read/write operations.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Multiplication order determined by the graded algebra structure; composition operations are executed sequentially.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One scalar multiplication and addition per product operation.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Group multiplication is a bijection on the basis; the operation is deterministically reversible via the involution, so no entropy is generated.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A single basis element b_{i+j mod 7} in the result register.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Two basis elements b_i and b_j in respective registers.
